title: Trust Issues Test: Do I Have Trust Issues?
searchIntent: do i have trust issues quiz

scoring.note: One evidence-context answer intentionally carries a low trust-difficulty value despite high evidence concern so justified caution is not inflated into an internal trust-issues score.

contextRules.evidenceConcern: Concrete breach answers are reported separately so a high trust-difficulty score does not automatically reframe justified caution as irrational distrust.
contextRules.personalization: Results use overall score, two strongest dimensions, evidence count, and response tags such as reassurance loops, checking behavior, past-to-present expectations, and difficulty updating.

methodology.design: scenario-based items written around ambiguity, reliance, closeness, reassurance, checking, repair, and evidence updating
researchBackground: Rempel, Holmes & Zanna (1985) - Trust in Close Relationships
Mikulincer (1998) - attachment working models and sense of trust
relationship research on attachment insecurity and reassurance-seeking
